data.fund_type: An open ended equity scheme investing in Pharma, Healthcare & allied sectors.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to seek to generate long term capital appreciation through investing in equity and equity related securities of companies benefitting directly or indirectly Pharma, Healthcare, and allied sectors. However, there is no assurance that the objective of the scheme will be achieved .
